hypotheses.reasoning: Starting at 18:49:12, the third-party email provider api.mailer.example quickly returns 502/503 errors to template-svc (#1623, #1630, #1665, #1693). Before that, template-svc rendered normally. At 18:50:29, template-svc's circuit breaker opened (#1721). Half-open probes at 18:54:34 and 18:58:29 still got 502 (#1981, #2244), so the provider stayed down. notification-svc's TemplateClient.render fails with 503 (circuit open), and api-gateway returns 503 on POST /v1/notify. These are downstream symptoms. No deploy was found. A separate IdP slowness (auth-svc to idp.example timing out, which saturates account-svc's pool) affects /login, not /notify.

At about the same time, idp.example calls from auth-svc time out after 30s and fill account-svc's pool to auth-svc. This explains the /login 503s at edge-proxy but is on a different path from POST /v1/notify. It is likely a co-occurring incident, not the cause of this alert.

verdict.recommendedAction: Check the api.mailer.example status page and open a ticket with the provider. Fail over to a backup email provider if one is set up, or queue notify sends to retry later instead of returning 503. Separately, page the auth owners about the idp.example timeouts that are breaking /login.
